title: Shadow Grave
wikitext:
[[Image:Shadow Grave.jpg|thumb|Shadow Grave]]
'''Shadow Grave''' is a crypt that lies at the top of a slope along the [[Tirisfal Glades]] mountains, just above the [[Forsaken]] village of [[Deathknell]]. A path runs down from Shadow Grave to Deathknell. 

It is this crypt in which every undead [[player character]] "comes back to life" after character creation.
